cycle.label: License cycle
cycle.note: Two CE years per license cycle, each July 1 – June 30. Licenses renew July 31.

requirements.label: Total hours each year
requirements.note: 40 hours each CE year (July 1 – June 30). Up to 40 extra hours carry into the next year.

requirements.label: Self-study & nano
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 20 hours of self-study and nano-learning count per CE year (R 338.5215).

requirements.label: Michigan statutes & rules (ethics)
requirements.note: 1 of the 4 ethics hours in each two-year cycle must cover Michigan's accountancy statutes and rules (the MICPA course). We count courses with "Michigan" and "rules", "statutes" or "ethics" in the title.

newLicensee.note: Not required yet — no CE is due for the first 12 months after your original license.

licenseDateHint: Michigan licenses renew July 31 every two years (e.g. 07/31/2027). CE years run July 1 – June 30.
issueDateHint: Your original license date — no CE is due for the first 12 months.
limitsNotTracked: Teaching: max 20 hours per CE year (3 hours per 50 minutes).
No credit for repeating substantially equivalent content in the same period.
recordRetention: Keep CE records for 4 years after applying for renewal (R 338.5210).
toVerify: Carryforward (MCL 339.729): modelled as own excess hours of the previous CE year only (a carryover isn't carried again), max 40 total / 8 A&A / 2 ethics.
New licensees: a CE year partly inside the first 12 months is prorated by days (the statute just says CE isn't required for 12 months).
Self-study/nano cap read as 20 per CE year ('per period', where R 338.5101 defines a CE period as July 1 – June 30).
Both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the ethics hours; the Michigan rules course is matched by title.
